220110101.text: Ugh... who on earth is spreading this rumor?...

220110103.text: About the fortune slips at the shrine.

220110104.text: You know what fortune slips are, right? To put it simply, they are a form of astrology done by drawing lots.

220110105.text: You can reveal some simple fortunes from the wording on the slip you get.

220110106.text: If you get a good sign, great. But people usually leave the bad signs at the shrine to rid themselves of the bad fortune.

220110107.text: But... a rumor has somehow spread that if you throw the bad slips to the top of the tree, your bad luck will be dispelled by the archon.

220110108.text: Here's the funniest part: some people even think that the higher you throw it, the faster the good luck will come and the faster the bad luck will dissipate. What nonsense!

220110109.text: As the rumors got more and more outrageous, people have started throwing Mora up the tree, too!

220110110.text: It's said that if the Mora you threw gets stuck in the branches, that means that your prayer has been accepted. Not only will your wish come true, but you will also enjoy good luck for a whole year.

220110112.text: Of course not! Let's put aside whether individual prayers can be heard or not... throwing Mora is just way off. Besides, Mora all look the same, don't they?

220110113.text: Are they expecting the archon to pick up the Mora one by one to figure out who they are from?

220110116.text: I understand that they want to pray for blessings, but... throwing things up there won't get them any.

220110117.text: Besides, it all falls down once the wind kicks up.

220110118.text: I've tried to clean the tree up by myself, but I'm not very athletic. Not only did I fail to clean it up, but I got stuck for a long time and couldn't get down...

220110119.text: But I can't just leave it unattended... Traveler, could you help me go up the roof to clean up a little?

220110115.text: There are too many people doing it now. I don't think I can convince everyone...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the roof to clean up

220110203.text: Thank you very much. Leave the fortune slips to me and I'll hang them up in the right place.

220110204.text: Please take these as thanks for your help.

220110205.text: I understand that people are desperate to get rid of bad luck and to get good luck...

220110206.text: But I think that if they really want to solve their problems, their own actions will be more effective than fortune slips.

220110207.text: How do they expect the gods to offer help if they don't take any action themselves...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the roof to clean up

220110301.text: Seriously, why do people believe in rumors that don't make sense if you just thought about them for a second?

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the roof to clean up
